meta.datasetName: Ohio Down Payment Assistance & Grant Programs
meta.coverage: Statewide Ohio — OHFA statewide programs plus major-metro local programs (Cleveland/Cuyahoga, Columbus/Franklin, Cincinnati/Hamilton, Dayton/Montgomery, Akron/Summit/Stark, Toledo/Lucas, Lima/Allen).
meta.disclaimer: Program terms, funding availability, income limits, and purchase-price limits change frequently and many programs are first-come/first-served or periodically closed between funding rounds. Treat every record as a starting point and confirm current details with the program administrator before relying on it. 'verify' means the field was not authoritatively confirmed at compile time.

fieldNotes.requiresHomebuyerEd: true means a HUD-approved homebuyer education certificate is required — this is the field that should be visually highlighted as 'unlocked by your certificate' in the finder.
fieldNotes.incomeLimit: AMI = Area Median Income for the county/household size. Where a percentage is given, eligibility is at or below that percentage of AMI unless noted.
fieldNotes.amountStructured: Best-effort machine-readable amount; 'amount' is the human-readable source of truth.

programs.name: OHFA Down Payment Assistance (Your Choice!)
programs.amount: 3% of purchase price (conventional) or 3.5% (FHA/VA/USDA), applied to down payment or closing costs

eligibility.firstTimeBuyerExceptions: Target areas and qualifying veterans may be exempt from the first-time requirement.
eligibility.incomeLimit: Varies by county; OHFA target and non-target income limits apply
eligibility.creditNote: 640+ for conventional/VA/USDA; 650+ for FHA (lender overlays may apply)
eligibility.propertyType: 1-4 unit residential, condos, modular, manufactured; owner-occupied

programs.repayment: Second mortgage forgiven after 7 years; full repayment required if sold or refinanced within 7 years.
programs.howToApply: Apply through an OHFA-approved lender; complete free HUD-approved homebuyer education.
programs.notes: OHFA's flagship statewide DPA. Stackable with OHFA's MTC and rate programs.

programs.name: OHFA Grants for Grads
programs.amount: 2.5% or 5% of purchase price toward down payment / closing costs

eligibility.occupationDetail: Must have earned an associate, bachelor's, master's, or doctorate degree within the past 48 months.

programs.repayment: Forgiven over 5 years (20% per year); repayment owed if home is sold/refinanced before 5 years.
programs.howToApply: Apply through an OHFA-approved lender; provide proof of degree within 48 months.
programs.notes: Aimed at retaining recent graduates in Ohio.

programs.name: OHFA Ohio Heroes
programs.amount: Discounted first-mortgage interest rate (commonly ~0.25% reduction); combinable with OHFA DPA

eligibility.occupationDetail: Veterans, active-duty military, police, firefighters, EMTs/paramedics, physicians, nurses, and teachers/administrators.

programs.repayment: Rate benefit (no repayment); any paired DPA follows that program's terms.
programs.howToApply: Apply through an OHFA-approved lender and document qualifying profession.
programs.notes: Profession-based rate discount; pairs with Your Choice! DPA and MTC.

programs.name: OHFA Next Home
programs.amount: Down payment assistance with a competitive rate; open to repeat (non-first-time) buyers
programs.repayment: Per OHFA DPA terms (verify current forgiveness schedule).
programs.howToApply: Apply through an OHFA-approved lender.
programs.notes: The main OHFA option for buyers who are NOT first-time buyers. Verify current structure with OHFA.

programs.name: OHFA Mortgage Tax Credit (MTC)
programs.amount: Federal income tax credit equal to a percentage of annual mortgage interest (commonly 20%-40% depending on MTC Basic vs MTC Plus)

eligibility.firstTimeBuyerExceptions: Not required in target areas; MTC Basic has broader eligibility than MTC Plus.

programs.repayment: N/A — annual federal tax credit for the life of the loan while owner-occupied.
programs.howToApply: Elect the MTC through an OHFA-approved lender at loan origination.
programs.notes: Ongoing yearly federal tax benefit; MTC Plus (paired with an OHFA loan) typically credits a higher percentage than standalone MTC Basic. Verify current percentages.

programs.name: Communities First — Ohio Down Payment Assistance
programs.provider: Port of Greater Cincinnati Development Authority (The Port)
programs.amount: 3% to 5% of the purchase price as a true grant (no lien, no repayment)
programs.repayment: True grant / gift — no repayment and no second lien.
programs.howToApply: Apply through a Communities First participating lender.
programs.notes: Statewide true grant (rare). Often carries a slightly higher first-mortgage rate in exchange for no-lien, no-repayment assistance. Not limited to first-time buyers.

programs.name: Cuyahoga County Down Payment Assistance Program
programs.provider: Cuyahoga County (serviced via CHN Housing Partners / Believe Mortgage)
programs.amount: Up to 10% of purchase price, maximum $20,900

eligibility.firstTimeBuyerDetail: Must not have owned a home in the past 3 years.
eligibility.incomeLimit: Low-to-moderate income; program income limits apply

participatingLenders: CHN Housing Partners / Believe Mortgage and partner lenders
programs.repayment: Must be current on all property taxes; confirm forgiveness/repayment terms with administrator.
programs.howToApply: Apply through CHN Housing Partners / a participating lender.
programs.notes: Covers ~51 eligible Cuyahoga communities but EXCLUDES Cleveland, Cleveland Heights, East Cleveland, Euclid, and Lakewood (each has its own program). Core program for the Golden Group's home market.

programs.name: Mayor's Neighborhood Transformation Initiative DPA (Glenville)
programs.provider: City of Cleveland / Believe Mortgage (CHN Housing Capital)

eligibility.incomeLimit: No hard cap; at/below 120% AMI contribute 3% down, above 120% AMI contribute 5% down

programs.repayment: 0% deferred second mortgage; forgiven after 5 years of owner-occupancy.
programs.howToApply: Apply via Believe Mortgage.
programs.notes: Part of Cleveland's $65M Neighborhood Transformation Initiative; geographically targeted.

programs.name: Cleveland Heights Down Payment Assistance Program
programs.provider: City of Cleveland Heights / Home Repair Resource Center (HRRC)
programs.amount: Up to 17% (≤80% AMI) or up to 13% (≤120% AMI) of price — max $30,000 either way

eligibility.incomeLimit: At or below HUD income guidelines by household size

programs.repayment: 0% deferred second mortgage held by the City; confirm terms with HRRC.
programs.howToApply: Apply through the City of Cleveland Heights / HRRC.
programs.notes: Dedicated local program because the county program excludes Cleveland Heights. One of the highest dollar caps in the state ($30,000).

programs.name: City of Lakewood Down Payment Assistance Loan Program
programs.repayment: Deferred; repayable at sale or refinance.
programs.howToApply: Apply through the City of Lakewood FTHB program.
programs.notes: Lakewood is excluded from the county program and runs its own.

programs.name: Euclid Down Payment Assistance Loan Program
programs.repayment: Forgivable on a schedule (confirm timeline with administrator).
programs.howToApply: Apply through Euclid Development Corporation.
programs.notes: Euclid is excluded from the county program and runs its own.

programs.name: Believe Mortgage Down Payment Assistance (Cuyahoga & Lorain)
programs.provider: Believe Mortgage (CHN Housing Capital / CHN Housing Partners)
programs.amount: Up to 10% of purchase price, maximum $20,900

eligibility.firstTimeBuyerDetail: Must not have owned a home in the past 3 years.

programs.repayment: Deferred; repayable upon sale, title transfer, or refinance.
programs.howToApply: Apply via Believe Mortgage.
programs.notes: Lender-administered product distinct from the county-administered Cuyahoga DPA. A Believe100 (100% financing) product also exists for higher-FICO borrowers; expanding toward Summit County.

programs.name: Columbus American Dream Downpayment Initiative (ADDI)
programs.amount: Up to $14,999 or 6% of price (lower of the two); up to $5,000 more for households ≤80% AMI

eligibility.firstTimeBuyerDetail: Applicant and spouse must not have owned a home in the prior 36 months.
eligibility.incomeLimit: At or below 120% AMI (HOME-funded units: ≤80% AMI)
eligibility.otherRequirements: 6 months Ohio residency; US permanent resident; $500 own funds in + $500 accessible after closing; PITI ≤35% income, total DTI ≤45%.

participatingLenders: Conventional, FHA, USDA, VA, 203K eligible lenders
programs.repayment: Forgivable after 5 years of occupancy; repaid from net proceeds if sold earlier.
programs.howToApply: Apply through the City of Columbus Housing Division; ~4-6 week approval, first-come.
programs.notes: Can be stacked with other (non-City) DPA programs.

programs.name: Franklin County Downpayment Assistance Program
programs.repayment: Deferred; repayable at sale or refinance.
programs.howToApply: Apply through Homeport.
programs.notes: Homeport also runs the Maude Hill Growing Homeownership Fund (separate record).

programs.name: Maude Hill Growing Homeownership Fund
programs.repayment: Deferred; repayable at sale or refinance.
programs.howToApply: Apply through Homeport.
programs.notes: Allows 2-4 unit and manufactured properties — broader property types than many programs.

programs.name: City of Cincinnati American Dream Downpayment Initiative (ADDI)
programs.provider: City of Cincinnati Community Development Department
programs.repayment: Forgivable after 5 years; pro-rated recapture if owner moves/sells/transfers before 5 years.
programs.howToApply: Apply through the City of Cincinnati Community Development Department.
programs.notes: First-time buyers only; relatively high price ceiling.

programs.name: Homebase Cincinnati Down Payment Assistance
programs.repayment: Deferred; repayable at sale or refinance.
programs.howToApply: Apply through Homebase Cincinnati.
programs.notes: Open to repeat buyers.

programs.name: FHLB Cincinnati Welcome Home Program
programs.provider: Federal Home Loan Bank of Cincinnati
programs.amount: Up to $20,000 (up to $25,000 for veterans, active military, and surviving spouses)

eligibility.firstTimeBuyerDetail: Not required to be first-time; first-time buyers must complete homeownership counseling.
eligibility.incomeLimit: Total occupant income at or below 80% of the MRB limit for the county/state
eligibility.propertyType: Single-family, condo, townhome, manufactured; primary residence
eligibility.otherRequirements: Buyer contributes ≥$500; no co-signers/non-occupant co-borrowers; max first-mortgage rate cap applies.

programs.repayment: Grant — no repayment; 5-year retention period with restrictive covenant on the deed.
programs.howToApply: Apply through a participating FHLB Cincinnati member lender during an open funding round.
programs.notes: FUNDING ROUNDS: first-come/first-served and frequently exhausted quickly (2026 round opened April 6, 2026). Often shows as 'closed' between rounds — finder should flag availability windows.

programs.name: City of Dayton Down Payment Assistance Program
programs.provider: City of Dayton — The HomeOwnership Center of Greater Dayton
programs.repayment: Deferred; repayable at sale or refinance.
programs.howToApply: Apply through The HomeOwnership Center of Greater Dayton.

programs.name: Montgomery County Down Payment Assistance Program
programs.amount: Up to 10% of purchase price, maximum $8,000
programs.repayment: 0% deferred; no repayment unless sold/refinanced/transferred/vacated or converted to rental.
programs.howToApply: Apply through The HomeOwnership Center of Greater Dayton.
programs.notes: Excludes Dayton and Kettering (own programs) and the Trotwood/Northwest Dayton area (separate program).

programs.name: Kettering First-Time Homebuyer Assistance Program
programs.provider: Day Air Credit Union in partnership with City of Kettering
programs.amount: Up to 10% of purchase price plus closing costs, maximum $20,000
programs.repayment: Forgivable over 5 years (20%/year); must remain primary residence.
programs.howToApply: Apply through Day Air Credit Union.
programs.notes: Originally ARPA-funded (~$1M+); verify current funding availability with Day Air.

programs.name: Miami Valley Fair Housing Center ICF Down Payment Assistance
programs.provider: Miami Valley Fair Housing Center with HomeOwnership Center of Greater Dayton
programs.amount: Up to 20% of purchase price (max $20,000) as an equity contribution

eligibility.incomeLimit: Targeted to communities of color in highest-foreclosure ZIPs (verify income rules)

programs.repayment: 0% deferred; 50% forgiven after 5 years of primary residency, remaining 50% due on sale/transfer/non-occupancy. Designed to reach 80% LTV and eliminate PMI.
programs.howToApply: Apply through Miami Valley Fair Housing Center.
programs.notes: Geographically restricted to ZIPs 45417 and 45426; one of the highest assistance percentages (20%).

programs.name: City of Akron Down Payment Assistance Program
programs.provider: City of Akron Planning and Urban Development
programs.repayment: Forgiven over time based on years of occupancy (confirm timeline with the City).
programs.howToApply: Apply through the City of Akron Planning Department.
programs.notes: Launched 2025 with a ~$300,000 HUD allocation targeting ~25 families; verify current availability.

programs.name: Summit County First Home, First Loan DPA Program
programs.provider: County of Summit Community & Economic Development
programs.amount: 3:1 match up to $12,000 (buyer contributes $4,000, county matches $12,000)
programs.repayment: 0% deferred, no-interest loan (confirm forgiveness terms with the County).
programs.howToApply: Apply through the County of Summit Community & Economic Development Dept.
programs.notes: HOME-funded. Excludes Akron, Barberton, and Cuyahoga Falls (own programs). Buyer must put in $4,000 to unlock the full $12,000 match.

programs.name: City of Canton Down Payment Assistance
programs.provider: Community Building Partnership of Stark County
programs.amount: Up to $5,000
programs.repayment: Deferred; repayable at sale or refinance.
programs.howToApply: Apply through Community Building Partnership of Stark County.

programs.name: City of Massillon Down Payment Assistance Program
programs.amount: 6-7% of purchase price (by income) plus up to $5,000 for code repairs post-purchase

eligibility.incomeLimit: Low-to-moderate income; Stark County limits apply

programs.repayment: Deferred (confirm forgiveness terms with the City's Housing office).
programs.howToApply: Apply through the City of Massillon Housing office.
programs.notes: Includes a post-purchase code-repair allowance — unusual and useful for older housing stock.

programs.name: City of Toledo Home At Last Program
programs.amount: Up to $12,500 (or up to $20,000 in targeted revitalization neighborhoods)
programs.repayment: 0% interest forgivable loan.
programs.howToApply: Apply through the City of Toledo.
programs.notes: Higher cap ($20,000) in targeted revitalization neighborhoods.

programs.name: First Home Lima
programs.repayment: Deferred; repayable at sale or refinance.
programs.howToApply: Apply through the City of Lima.
